evidence: Modifies prioritisetransaction in src/rpc/mining.cpp and functional tests in test/functional/mining_prioritisetransaction.py, directly impacting transaction inclusion in getblocktemplate.
rationale: Prevents prioritized transactions from being incorrectly omitted from getblocktemplate. The PR description shows that overflowing fee deltas across parent and child transactions resulted in negative chunk fees that caused block template construction to drop both transactions.
